name: @exre/exui-tokens
description: Framework-neutral visual tokens for Exre user interfaces.

scripts.build: pnpm build:js && node scripts/generate-css.mjs && node scripts/copy-css.mjs && node scripts/validate-tokens.mjs
scripts.tokens:check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm build:js && node scripts/generate-css.mjs --check && node scripts/copy-css.mjs && node scripts/validate-tokens.mjs
